comments.body:
Can be obtained from First Rank Merit Reward (No.1), Second Rank Merit Reward (No.1), and Third Rank Merit Reward (No.1) chests.

Durability 60/60
Formality 10
Disguise 10
Defense Power 30
Search +2
Recognition +2
Marching +2
Required Total Fame : 10000
EX Effect : Reduce Vigour consumption (Rank 3)

Note that this equipment is Unisex, meaning male and female toon can wear.
